comment: A union of one branch per staged source, not a join. fct_too_many_joins counts distinct direct parents (13 on int_pois_unioned, against too_many_joins_threshold 7), and a union of N sources has N parents by construction. The pattern matches today's int_pois_unioned and the int_<mart>__unioned models planned in #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads, where one branch per club puts every union past 7. It must never match a model that joins.

Loaded and not staged. DBT.md's Phase D note left it unstaged because sources.json then recorded no field name for it; the entry has since gained id_field GlobalID, name_field Name and unit_field MasterAreaID, but the CI fixture is still property-free (make_dbt_fixtures.py), so a staging model has nothing to build against yet. It is not unused by the pipeline: export_places.py reads it in Python for the park rows of places.json (#1371 — First run's "where do you hike" has nothing to search until the waypoints land, and no park is on any phone: publish a places index). Ends when the places mart stages it, with fixture fields to match, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

No id is recorded for this layer: sources.json has no id_field for it and its measured field list holds none, and ST_Read's OGC_FID is GDAL's row number for one fetch, which a republish in another order renumbers (DBT.md, Phase D). A primary-key test on OGC_FID would pass every build and still be wrong. Ends when a field-metadata read of the service gives the layer a key; finding the stable key per layer is part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

Fixable, and not fixed in the tooling stage. sources.json now declares id_field OBJECTID for this layer, the same declaration every DEC layer carries, and the DEC staging models stage cast(objectid as varchar) as source_id with not_null and unique. This model was written before the declaration (DBT.md, Phase D, says no id was recorded), and the CI fixture carries no OBJECTID (make_dbt_fixtures.py), so the fix is a change to the model and the fixture together. Ends when the porting stage of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads stages the key.

A reviewed file in git, not a fetched layer: its change marker is the file's sha256 (extract/_kinds.py's ReviewedFile), so its _loaded_at moves only when somebody edits the file, and any freshness threshold would warn about a list nobody needed to change while saying nothing about whether the extract ran, which _extract_runs records on every run. Ends if stage 5 of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads gives reviewed files a staleness rule of their own when it sets the per-cadence thresholds.

Its rows are the var trail_lines_coded_domains, a frozen copy of side_trails' Blaze and Type coded-value domains read from the live layer on 2026-10-02, because no extract lands a layer's field metadata yet: export_trails.py and export_spurs.py fetch the same domains live today (lib/arcgis.get_field_coded_domain). A model with no parent is what that copy is, and reading another model only to have one would hide it. tests/test_dbt_trail_lines_parity.py pins the var to the domains the exporters' own tests decode with. Ends when the extract lands each layer's fields[].domain.codedValues and this model reads that source instead, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.
